zizmor_missing: zizmor is not installed ({detail}). Run: jgates doctor --fix (it installs zizmor from PyPI into the JGates environment), or pip install zizmor.
zizmor_probe_failed: zizmor at {path} did not answer --version. Reinstall with: jgates doctor --fix.
zizmor_timeout: zizmor exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
zizmor_cancelled: The run was cancelled; zizmor was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
zizmor_invalid_output: The zizmor output is not the expected json-v1 JSON: {detail}
zizmor_no_invocation: The plan has no zizmor invocation for the instance {tool}.
zizmor_ignored: {count} finding(s) ignored by zizmor comments or zizmor.yml (scanner exceptions)
zizmor_condition_offline: Offline: no GitHub API call; the audits that need it (impostor commits, known vulnerable actions) are left out.
zizmor_condition_online: Online: the audits that ask the GitHub API run too and need a GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment of the run.
zizmor_condition_governed: jgates ci: zizmor.yml and ignore comments of the analyzed project are not honored.
zizmor_limitation_exceptions: zizmor: ignore comments and the ignore rules of zizmor.yml are scanner exceptions, not waivers of the gate.
zizmor_setting_persona: The persona of the instance {tool} is {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
zizmor_setting_min_severity: The minSeverity of the instance {tool} is {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
zizmor_setting_offline: The offline setting of the instance {tool} is {value}; use true or false.
